description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must publish the receiving and storage plan for four incoming sustainment pallets, assigning each pallet to a storage area, setting the unloading order, and recording the coordination actions required before the shipment is accepted.

shared_context.S1: Four pallets are scheduled to arrive at the battalion receiving point at 0830: water-treatment chemicals, refrigerated medical cold packs, generator air filters, and battery modules.
shared_context.S2: The available storage areas are the ventilated chemical shed, the medical cold room, the secure parts cage, and the covered outbound staging bay.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez must approve the receiving plan, and each pallet must be assigned to one storage area before unloading begins.
shared_context.S4: The receiving point can unload one pallet at a time, and the warehouse's routine receiving huddle occurs before the daily plan is published; the warehouse, medical logistics, maintenance, and movement-control representatives provide their normal updates at that huddle.

PF1.text: SFC Brooks confirmed from the warehouse handling sheet this morning that the water-treatment chemicals are corrosive and must be placed in the ventilated chemical shed; the revised handling sheet has not yet been attached to the receiving packet.

PF2.text: Lt. Shah confirmed that the medical cold packs must remain at 2-8 degrees Celsius and therefore must go directly into the medical cold room; the temperature requirement is in the clinic's shipment email but has not yet been copied into the battalion receiving brief.

PF3.text: CWO Mercer confirmed that the generator air filters are reserved for the 1000 maintenance inspection and must be unloaded third so the maintenance section can collect them immediately after the medical pallet; the reservation is recorded in the motor-pool work log but has not yet been entered on the receiving board.

PF4.text: SSG Okafor received a higher-headquarters release instruction this morning requiring the battery modules to be staged in the covered outbound staging bay for partner-unit pickup by 1500; the instruction is still awaiting entry in the movement-control tracker.

acceptance_conditions: The water-treatment chemicals must be assigned to the ventilated chemical shed.
The refrigerated medical cold packs must be assigned to the medical cold room.
The generator air filters must be unloaded third.
The battery modules must be assigned to the covered outbound staging bay.
The plan must include a chemical-handling confirmation.
The plan must include a cold-chain handoff confirmation.
The plan must include a maintenance pickup coordination action.
The plan must include a partner-unit pickup coordination action.
The higher-headquarters release instruction must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The corrosive classification changes the chemical pallet's storage assignment to the ventilated chemical shed and requires the chemical-handling confirmation.
The 2-8 degree requirement changes the cold-pack pallet's storage assignment to the medical cold room and requires the cold-chain handoff confirmation.
The 1000 maintenance inspection reservation changes the air-filter pallet's unloading position to third and requires the maintenance pickup coordination action.

The higher-headquarters release instruction changes the battery pallet's storage assignment to the covered outbound staging bay, requires partner-unit pickup coordination, and supplies the instruction that must be cited.
